title: Report Readiness / QA Center
notes: Adds Report Readiness to both the Drill Log and Shot Diagram menus.
Shows READY FOR REPORT or REVIEW REQUIRED with blocking issue and advisory counts.
Identifies the actual page and hole IDs affected by every field-data issue.
Checks Drill Logs for missing or impossible depth and overburden values.
Checks Shot Diagrams for missing dimensions, explosive loads, and loaded-hole timing.
Validates explosive entry syntax and ANFO/dink footage against the available loaded column.
Treats pumped emulsion entries in pounds as valid manual loads without forcing a footage-balance calculation.
Treats missing job, date, shot/drill-log number, and personnel fields as advisories rather than blocking field-data failures.
Provides a direct PDF action only after blocking issues are cleared.
Does not change hole data and does not claim that the physical shot is safe or ready to fire.
Preserves standardized PDF summaries, loading configurations, configurable Auto ANFO, inferred timing, Page Order / Renumber, iPad entry layout, and cloud sync behavior.
